text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school. Hishi Miracle was 
humming a tune while looking at her 
smartphone.
choice_data_list: Did something good happen or what?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. On my next day off, I'm going to 
an okonomiyaki place.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It's my favorite shop lately. The dough 
is so fluffy, and it's packed full of huge 
chunks of fillings!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
They're super particular about their 
ingredients over there. The menu actually 
changes depending on what they can source!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you might never encounter 
that exact same okonomiyaki again~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"So that I have no regrets, I'm going to 
savor the flavors of the season even if it 
means pushing my stomach past its limit!"
choice_data_list: Eat as much as you want and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's totally fine. Okonomiyaki has 
cabbage in it, so it's healthy~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind, but... are you perhaps 
worried that I might eat too much?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha~ you really don't trust me, huh? 
Though to be honest, I'm not so sure I can 
hold back either...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Ah, right. If the two of us are going...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If I share with you, Trainer, I can eat 
all sorts of different kinds~ Don't you 
think that's a stroke of genius?
choice_data_list:
I came on an empty stomach, so leave it to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I enjoyed okonomiyaki together 
with Hishi Miracle, successfully 
preventing her from overeating.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Trainer gave me permission too, so 
I'm gonna collect them all~! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there are so many seafood okonomiyaki 
options this time~. I wonder if this 
combination is good? I'm so curious~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna chow down today~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle thoroughly enjoyed a massive 
serving of okonomiyaki to her heart's 
content.
